marie: Quick heads-up: LockForge says the HSM-backed KMS connector is ready for a final interoperability run and marketplace listing. We need SSO/SAML metadata, SCIM write access for staging, and an embargo window for a joint announcement.
nisha: Got it. Please share SAML metadata + SCIM base URL. Also confirm key wrapping protocol (PKCS#11 vs KMIP) and whether you can provide non-prod wrapping keys for staging.
henry: For SCIM mapping we'll need group -> entitlement mapping and one example PATCH we can hit. Example we use:
```
PATCH /scim/v2/Groups/{id}
Content-Type: application/json
{ "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"], "Operations": [{"op":"replace","path":"members","value": [{"value":"user-123","display":"redwood-test"}]}] }
```
alex (LockForge): Hi all — LockForge confirms PKCS#11 + KMIP supported. We'll spin up a staging slot and enable SCIM write for one test tenant tomorrow. SAML metadata: https://saml.lockforge.com/metadata.xml. SCIM base: https://staging-api.lockforge.com/scim. We'll provide staged wrapping keys and perf numbers.
sam (marketing): Proposed comms: if certing and staging tests complete by 2026-03-28 we can aim for an announcement week of 2026-04-10. Need logos, one-line partner blurb, and marketplace screenshots. Request marketing assets by 2026-04-06 EOD.
josh (legal): We'll need the joint statement reviewed by both legal teams and the NDA status confirmed. Please route any contract language to legal@redwood.example. Tentative embargo until 2026-04-10 16:00 UTC, subject to sign-off.
stratussi-liaison: StratusSI here — coordinating a pilot customer for the week after go-live. Who's the SAML provisioning contact? We need an IdP test endpoint and sample assertions.
nisha: @stratussi-liaison send SP metadata and contact email. We'll provision an ephemeral IdP and share a SAML response sample. Reminder: do not paste secrets in Slack; use the partner vault link.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] marketplace assets uploaded: /artifacts/marketplace/lockforge-hsm-kms-assets-2376543210.zip
henry: Small ask for the marketplace card: can you provide a conservative 95p latency for the HSM KMS path and any hardware offload notes (e.g., CPU or NVMe usage) so we can include a footnote on performance/cost?
alex (LockForge): We'll run an overnight perf sweep and send 95p numbers + minimal system requirements by EOD Wed.
marie: Action recap: 1) LockForge to enable SCIM write on staging and deliver perf numbers + wrapping key test slot (alex). 2) Eng to run SAML/SCIM certing and mapping (nisha, henry). 3) Marketing to collect assets and draft copy (sam). 4) Legal to clear embargo/NDAs (josh). 5) StratusSI to send SP metadata for pilot (stratussi-liaison). 6) Use partner vault for any creds. I'll follow up with a calendar invite and a verification checklist.
marie: Thanks everyone — please flag blockers ASAP. :thumbsup:
